from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    separator = len(grid[0]) // 2
    left = [row[:separator] for row in grid]
    right = [row[separator + 1:] for row in grid]
    background = Counter(value for row in right for value in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    return [[3 if left[r][c] == right[r][c] else background for c in range(len(right[0]))] for r in range(len(grid))]
